decision: BTCUSDT-first: optimize the pipeline (dedupe condition x world, parallelise independent tasks up to 4 workers) and run structural controls + TE-04/TE-05 on BTCUSDT only; expand to 5 symbols only after BTC demonstrates potential
rationale: time edge is treated as a structural property; if it exists it should not vanish across symbols. A symbol-by-symbol disappearance would itself be the finding to investigate.
expansion_rule: a 5-symbol round is a separate registered phase, run only after the BTC study reaches its claim gate

optimization.dedupe: targets/model fits shared between the two conditions per world
optimization.parallelism: independent tasks may run with up to 4 workers/4 CPU; per-arm compute stays equal
optimization.rule: no resolution reduction, no dropped audit, no fabricated fills
